text: A fitness coach who dropped 60 pounds over the past year is now offering personalized nutrition guidance to clients struggling with weight management. With no formal training in dietetics or nutritional science, she bases her meal plans on her own weight loss journey, claiming that her personal transformation gives her the authority to advise others on complex dietary needs.
